title: The Hollow Sermon
text: A preacher of the Court stands on a box in an empty square, speaking to a crowd that is not there. He pauses for their laughter. He nods at their questions. His words are clever and warm, and they work their way into your ears like water into a crack.

options.label: Listen to his sermon to the end, and learn what the Court preaches.

outcomes.text: Now you understand the Court, and you wish you did not.
You almost agree with him, though you cannot remember why that frightens you.

options.label: The wisest argues back, before his words take root.

outcomes.text: The preacher falls silent. The empty crowd turns on him.
He is much better at this than you. The empty crowd laughs at you.

options.label: Stop your ears and walk on, before his words find their way in.

outcomes.text: You hear it anyway, faintly, like water in the walls.
